title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.5.1
subtitle: A Dev repair for existing Dev installations.

highlights.title: Dev Update Repaired
highlights.description: The old Dev updater accepts this repair as a Dev release through your existing feed. No channel switch is required.

highlights.title: Cumulative Update Feeds
highlights.description: After this update, Dev accepts Stable, Beta, and Dev releases; Beta accepts Stable and Beta; Stable accepts only Stable.

highlights.title: Username and Heartbeat Removed
highlights.description: The username preference, first-run prompt, installation identity storage, and periodic installation heartbeat remain removed.
